clue.text: One who says he's a Housemaster!

definitions.meaning: anyone talking or addressing an audience
the presiding officer who keeps order in the House of Commons

explanation.walkthrough: The Speaker chairs the UK House of Commons, so he is master of the House, not of a school boarding house.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who talks is literally a talker, and the Commons chair holds that title officially.

clue.text: Aspirations affecting the rest of us

definitions.text: Aspirations affecting the rest of us

parts.words: Aspirations affecting the rest of us
parts.note: hopes and ambitions, and also the visions that come to everyone during sleep, the nightly rest

explanation.walkthrough: 'The rest of us' looks like 'other people', but rest here is sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambitions are what one longs for, and night visions visit sleepers during their rest.

clue.text: Employ it in a song of praise concerning the tournament

indicators.note: the verb is placed within the song, splitting it open

parts.note: a carol is a joyful hymn of praise, especially at Christmas
to employ is to use

explanation.surface: Someone is told to put a hymn to work at a jousting event.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' is a link word. A carousel was originally a knightly tournament of tilting and riding displays, before the fairground ride took the name.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically the word named a chivalric tilting contest with horsemen, the sense older than the merry-go-round.

clue.text: Training programme prepared by the chef?

definitions.meaning: a series of lessons or classes in a subject
one part of a meal, such as the starter or main dish

explanation.definitionFit: A study syllabus and a stage of a meal share this one word.

clue.text: Order the fighters to get up and put it in code

definitions.text: Order the fighters to get up
definitions.meaning: to send fighter aircraft hurriedly into the air
to make a message unreadable without a key

explanation.definitionFit: RAF pilots were ordered aloft in a rush, and encrypting a signal jumbles it.

clue.text: The language of science? Quite the opposite

definitions.text: The language of science? Quite the opposite

parts.words: The language of science? Quite the opposite
parts.note: swap the phrase round to get the science of language, the study of its rules and structure

explanation.walkthrough: Reversing the phrase gives the science of language: the study of syntax and word forms.
explanation.definitionFit: The study of how words combine into sentences is the systematic science of a language.

clue.text: Fight and beat an old soldier

parts.note: to spar is to fight or box
to tan someone is to beat or thrash them

explanation.surface: A veteran warrior is attacked and thrashed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beat' as TAN is the old idiom 'tan your hide'. Sparta was the Greek city famed for its warriors.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen of ancient Sparta, the militaristic Greek state, was a soldier from boyhood.

clue.text: Business anxiety

definitions.meaning: a firm or company
worry or care about something

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a commercial enterprise and a feeling of worry.

clue.text: Prior to this leader is second-in-command

definitions.text: Prior to this leader is second-in-command

parts.words: Prior to this leader is second-in-command
parts.note: a prior in a monastery ranks just below the head of the house, so relative to that head he is the deputy

explanation.walkthrough: 'Prior to' looks like 'before', but Prior is the monastic rank under the head of an abbey.
explanation.definitionFit: The superior of a monastery has a prior as his deputy, the second in authority.

clue.text: It was beneath the Romans to bury people here!

definitions.text: It was beneath the Romans to bury people here!

parts.words: It was beneath the Romans to bury people here!
parts.note: the idiom 'beneath them' suggests disdain, but literally these burial tunnels lay under Rome

explanation.walkthrough: 'beneath the Romans' reads as 'below their dignity'; really it is the underground cemeteries of early Christian Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: Underground galleries with niches for tombs, famously beneath ancient Rome, served as burial places.

clue.text: Services brand new equipment for them when the State does

definitions.text: Services brand new equipment for them when the State does

parts.words: Services brand new equipment for them when the State does
parts.note: the armed services get fresh weapons when the government supplies them again

explanation.walkthrough: 'Services' looks like a verb; it is the armed forces, and the State's action is to supply them with weapons once more.
explanation.definitionFit: To supply with weapons again is to restock an army's arsenal, as a nation does for its forces.

clue.text: Sales? Point out vou aren't allowed to keep things from them

definitions.text: vou aren't allowed to keep things from them

indicators.note: out signals that the letters are put out of their order and rearranged

parts.note: the word as written
E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A shopper is warned that bargains in the sales cannot be kept.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' is the anagram signal, turning SALES plus E into a new word. The newspaper misprinted 'you' as 'vou'. A rented thing must be handed back.
explanation.definitionFit: Rental agreements let you use property for a term but never own it outright.

clue.text: Vessel not covered in the list of small shipping

definitions.text: Vessel not covered in the list of small shipping

parts.words: Vessel not covered in the list of small shipping
parts.note: a small craft with no deck over it, listed among minor shipping

explanation.walkthrough: 'not covered' sounds like 'omitted from the list', but means the craft has no deck.
explanation.definitionFit: An undecked small craft, such as a rowing dinghy, lies uncovered to the sky.

clue.text: Continuing to produce liquor?

definitions.meaning: as in 'it is raining yet', meaning persisting
a distilling apparatus for spirits

explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means yet or even now, and the noun is the apparatus for distilling spirits.

clue.text: Slow moving being the Legions' secret defensive formation

definitions.meaning: a famously sluggish shelled reptile
the Roman testudo, soldiers locking shields over their heads like a shell

explanation.walkthrough: The 'secret' is that the Roman testudo formation was named after the shelled creature it resembled.
explanation.definitionFit: A plodding reptile, and the Roman name for an interlocked shield wall, which meant the same animal.

clue.text: Soak? Very much inclined to be

definitions.meaning: to leave in liquid, as tea or washing
sharply sloping, like a hillside

explanation.definitionFit: To infuse in liquid, and a sharp gradient, share the one word.

clue.text: Dr. silent about grasping things

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so these letters are reordered

parts.note: the abbreviation for doctor, taken as its letters
the word as written

explanation.surface: A doctor keeps quiet on the subject of greed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'concerning' but signals the anagram of DR and SILENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Climbing plants put out thin coiling shoots that clasp supports to haul themselves up.

clue.text: Celestial visitors burning for the chance to give us a wish!

definitions.text: Celestial visitors burning for the chance to give us a wish!

parts.words: Celestial visitors burning for the chance to give us a wish!
parts.note: shooting stars blaze as they enter the air, and folklore says seeing one lets you make a wish

explanation.walkthrough: 'burning for the chance' reads as eagerness, but these visitors literally burn up in the atmosphere.
explanation.definitionFit: Rocks from space glow and burn up on entry, seen as shooting stars.

clue.text: Prophetic religious teaching, as it were?

definitions.text: Prophetic religious teaching, as it were?

parts.words: Prophetic religious teaching, as it were?
parts.note: the faith revealed through the Prophet Muhammad

explanation.walkthrough: 'Prophetic' means 'of the Prophet', Muhammad, rather than foretelling the future.
explanation.definitionFit: The Muslim faith rests on the teaching revealed to Muhammad, called simply the Prophet.

clue.text: In a moment of weakness, made a show of strength

definitions.text: In a moment of weakness, made a show of strength

parts.words: In a moment of weakness, made a show of strength
parts.note: when actually weak, pretended to be strong, as a card player does with a poor hand

explanation.walkthrough: 'In a moment of weakness' suggests giving in; here the person was weak and faked strength.
explanation.definitionFit: To pretend confidence or power one lacks is to deceive by bravado, as in poker.

clue.text: Unbeatable good advice to the Peeping Tom?

definitions.meaning: without equal, matchless

definitions.text: good advice to the Peeping Tom
definitions.meaning: split in two, telling a voyeur to look less

explanation.walkthrough: Split as PEER LESS, the word advises a voyeur to look less. A Peeping Tom is someone who spies on others undressing.
explanation.definitionFit: Having no equal or match means no one can better you.

clue.text: Island celebrated by Christians

definitions.meaning: the Pacific island famous for its huge stone heads
the spring festival of the Resurrection

explanation.definitionFit: The remote Pacific island of the moai statues, and the chief Christian feast, share the name.

clue.text: Petrol, all set to become a weapon

definitions.text: Petrol, all set to become a weapon

parts.words: Petrol, all set to become a weapon
parts.note: gasoline thickened into a jelly that sticks and burns, used as an incendiary weapon

explanation.walkthrough: 'all set' looks like 'ready'; it means the fuel has literally set into a gel.
explanation.definitionFit: Jellied gasoline was used as an incendiary weapon in firebombs and flamethrowers.

clue.text: Father, perhaps, equal to his child

parts.note: on a par means equal
a man's child, here a son

explanation.surface: A dad is said to stand level with his offspring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' flags that a clergyman is only one kind of Father: priests are addressed so.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman, who may be addressed as Father, is a vicar or rector.

clue.text: Do men's attitudes change about evil spirits?

indicators.note: the change of attitude is a change of position for these letters, which are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether men alter their views on wicked spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'attitudes change' signals the anagram of DO MEN'S; 'about' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Malevolent supernatural beings are fiends or devils.

clue.text: The skill of the songwriter apparently used to transport people

parts.note: a songwriter's work is an air, a tune
craft means skill

explanation.surface: A tunesmith's artistry seems to carry listeners away.
explanation.walkthrough: The skill of a songwriter would be 'air craft', the craft of making tunes. 'transport' here is literal travel, not rapture.
explanation.definitionFit: Planes and helicopters are flying machines that carry passengers.

clue.text: Got the salad ready-got ready for dinner

definitions.meaning: put oil and vinegar on the leaves
put on formal clothes for the evening

explanation.definitionFit: Adding a vinaigrette to leaves and putting on evening clothes share one verb.

clue.text: Finished everywhere

definitions.meaning: ended, done with
throughout, in every place

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means at an end, as in 'the match is done', and also throughout every place.
